=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh:237-250 (_abg_c2), 425-426 and 690-692 (abg_scan / abg_post `commits/${head}/statuses?per_page=100`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both status lookups (scan and post re-check) read only the first page of 100 commit statuses, so an older `ai-review/head-gate=failure` pushed past page 1 is invisible to `_abg_c2`, which can then return `true status_missing` after 60 minutes.
  WHY: The break-glass flow can then post `ai-review/head-gate=success` over an existing `failure`, which breaks the plan rule "a `failure` is respected and escalated, never overridden". All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 notes the practical likelihood is low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped it as a finding (speculative, needs >100 statuses on one SHA) and filed it as a hardening suggestion only.
- scripts/alert_self_fix.sh:177-227 (_asf_compose_prompt) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `evidence` field of the diagnosis JSON is said to be injected unsanitised into the IMPLEMENT-role prompt.
  WHY: An attacker-controlled diagnosis could inject instructions or forge `=== END UNTRUSTED DIAGNOSIS ===` fences and hijack the edit stage. Source severity was BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute it: only summary/proposed_fix/files/decisions reach the prompt via defang(), and `evidence` is used only in _asf_compose_body (line 519) after a strict run-URL fullmatch.
- scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh:607-611 (abg_test) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Condition 5 selects tests with `find tests -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'test_*.py'`, which ignores test files in subdirectories.
  WHY: Tests in subdirectories would not run, so the break-glass scan could pass condition 5 without full verification. Source severity was MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute it because the pytest suite is flat under `tests/`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "every `tests/test_*.py` of the head passes in the network-less gate container" (linked issue #10080, "Done" / scope item 3 condition 5)
  expected_change_site: scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh, abg_test (the `find tests -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'test_*.py'` line)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `find -maxdepth 1` lists only direct children of `tests/` and leaves out subdirectory tests (e.g. `tests/integration/test_*.py`). The current tree is flat, but a future subdirectory test would silently bypass condition 5. Source severity: NIT.
- requirement: "The full test suite passes on the head SHA in a credential-free job."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh`, `abg_test`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: At line 613, test selection is limited to top-level `tests/test_*.py`. CI also runs the shell test modules `tests/test_emit_event.sh`, `tests/test_transcript_archive.sh` and `tests/test_worktree_gc.sh` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:1092-1117`). Those paths are allowed by the break-glass path check, but condition 5 does not run them. Source severity: MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh:`abg_scan` statuses fetch (per_page=100, the `commits/${head}/statuses?per_page=100` call feeding `_abg_c2`) and the same lookup repeated in `abg_post` before the POST; `_abg_c2` (python block: `mine = [item ... context == context]`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The lookup reads only the first 100 statuses (newest first), so a head-gate `failure` past page 1 leaves `mine` empty, and `_abg_c2` returns `true status_missing` once the push is older than 60 minutes. `abg_post` repeats the same lookup.
  WHY: `ai-review/head-gate=success` can be posted over a `failure`, breaking "a `failure` is respected and escalated, never overridden" (docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md condition 2). Neither call site paginates, and the ledger `pushed_at` re-check does not cover the dropped page.
- NOTE: Gemini's `evidence` BLOCKER is called factually wrong, because `evidence` never enters the prompt and is used only as `Refs:` after a strict run-URL fullmatch. Gemini's `find -maxdepth 1` MAJOR is called not a gap, because the suite is flat and an empty result blocks with `no_tests`. The last-run diff is doc/comment-only and accurate. The `Refs #<tracking>` NIT was accepted as residual and is not re-flagged.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
